name: TrustDemoDT05
title: TD.DT.05 Does the portal release the manifest for this request?
description: For one manifest request (ITI-YY5), decide whether the portal releases the manifest, and what the access log records. Requirements: STD-ACC-001. Hit policy FIRST: the rules are tried in order and the first that matches applies.

action.title: Rule 1
action.description: When withdrawn is true: release = false; auditOutcome = 4; refusalReason = withdrawn. STD-ACC-001 (revoke): a withdrawn link releases nothing; the attempt is logged.

action.title: Rule 2
action.description: When withdrawn is false and withinPeriod is false: release = false; auditOutcome = 4; refusalReason = expired. STD-ACC-001 (expiry): a link opened outside the holder's period (J4: 2026-10-26 to 2026-11-09, Consent TrustDemoJ4Consent) releases nothing.

action.title: Rule 3
action.description: When withdrawn is false and withinPeriod is true and passcodeMatches is false: release = false; auditOutcome = 4; refusalReason = wrong-passcode. STD-ACC-001 (passcode): a wrong passcode releases nothing and is logged at home (AuditEvent TrustDemoJ41WrongPasscode).

action.title: Rule 4
action.description: When withdrawn is false and withinPeriod is true and passcodeMatches is true: release = true; auditOutcome = 0. The manifest is released and the access logged (AuditEvent TrustDemoJ41Access).
